The '''Aeromak''' was a hunting spear used on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] by both the indigenous [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] and [[the Doomed]]&mdash;the descendants of stranded [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. It was used for the purpose of combat and hunting predators.
